cn_steps: 在 `Edit > Plugins` 的 Virtual Production 分组启用 `Custom Details View`（模块 `CustomDetailsView`）并重启；它是可嵌入的属性树工厂，不是关卡组件。
在你的编辑器/VP 模块 `Build.cs` 加入 `CustomDetailsView`，`#include "CustomDetailsViewModule.h"` 与 `ICustomDetailsView.h`。
调用 `ICustomDetailsViewModule::Get().CreateCustomDetailsView(FCustomDetailsViewArgs)` 拿到 `TSharedRef<ICustomDetailsView>`；在 `FCustomDetailsViewArgs` 里设 `bAllowSearch`、`bShowKeyable`、要排除的类别。
对选中的 `UObject`/`AActor` 调用 `SetObjects`，把返回的 Slate（`SCustomDetailsView`）塞进 Remote Control、nDisplay 或自研 VP 面板，而不是打开默认 `Details` 面板。
用 `FCustomDetailsViewItemId` / `GetRootItem` 只展开需要的属性路径；属性改完后走对象自己的事务，确认关卡里对应 Actor 已脏且可撤销。
不要把 `CustomDetailsView` 写进 Game Target；Shipping 包没有这套编辑器细节视图。
en_steps: Enable `Custom Details View` under `Edit > Plugins` (Virtual Production, module `CustomDetailsView`) and restart. It is an embeddable property-tree factory, not a level component.
Add `CustomDetailsView` to your editor/VP module `Build.cs` and include `CustomDetailsViewModule.h` plus `ICustomDetailsView.h`.

Call `ICustomDetailsViewModule::Get().CreateCustomDetailsView(FCustomDetailsViewArgs)` to get a `TSharedRef<ICustomDetailsView>`; set `bAllowSearch`, `bShowKeyable`, and category filters on `FCustomDetailsViewArgs`.
Pass selected `UObject`/`AActor` instances to `SetObjects` and host the `SCustomDetailsView` widget inside Remote Control, nDisplay, or a custom VP panel instead of the default Details tab.
Use `FCustomDetailsViewItemId` / `GetRootItem` to expand only the property paths you need; edits go through the object's transaction so the actor dirties and undo works.
Keep `CustomDetailsView` off Game targets; shipping builds do not host this editor details view.
note_cn: VP 用的嵌入式 Details 控件，不是 Window 菜单里的独立工具。
note_en: Embedded VP details widget, not a standalone Window-menu tool.

cn_steps: 启用 `Custom Mesh Component`（运行时模块 `CustomMeshComponent`）；游戏模块 `Build.cs` 加上同名依赖。
给 Actor 添加 `UCustomMeshComponent`（蓝图组件名 `Custom Mesh`），指定材质槽 0 的 `UMaterialInterface`。
在蓝图或 C++ 填 `TArray<FCustomMeshTriangle>`：每个三角是 `Vertex0`/`Vertex1`/`Vertex2`（`FVector`），再调用 `SetCustomMeshTriangles`。
运行中增量网格用 `AddCustomMeshTriangles`；整段重建前先 `ClearCustomMeshTriangles`，避免旧三角残留。
PIE 里从不同角度检查法线朝向（顶点顺序为顺时针/逆时针）；需要碰撞时另挂 `UProceduralMeshComponent` 或静态碰撞，本组件只负责渲染。
比 `Procedural Mesh Component` 更轻：无 UV/切线/多段碰撞 API，适合调试线框、简单动态面片，不要用它替代完整 PMC/Geometry Script。
en_steps: Enable `Custom Mesh Component` (runtime module `CustomMeshComponent`) and add that module to the game `Build.cs`.
Add a `UCustomMeshComponent` (`Custom Mesh`) to an actor and assign a `UMaterialInterface` on element 0.
Fill a `TArray<FCustomMeshTriangle>` whose `Vertex0`/`Vertex1`/`Vertex2` are `FVector`s, then call `SetCustomMeshTriangles`.
Use `AddCustomMeshTriangles` for incremental updates; call `ClearCustomMeshTriangles` before a full rebuild so stale triangles do not remain.
In PIE, orbit the mesh to check winding/normals. Add a separate `UProceduralMeshComponent` or static collision if you need physics — this component is render-only.
Lighter than Procedural Mesh Component: no UV/tangent/section-collision API. Use it for debug surfaces and simple dynamic patches, not as a PMC/Geometry Script replacement.
note_cn: 可进包装的运行时网格；只有三角列表，没有 PMC 那套分段与碰撞。
note_en: Shippable runtime mesh; triangle list only, no PMC sections or collision.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 插件 `Customizable Sequencer Tracks (Experimental)`（运行时 `CustomizableSequencerTracks`，编辑器 `CustomizableSequencerTracksEditor`）。
内容浏览器右键 `Blueprint Class`，父类选 `MovieSceneCustomizableTrack` / `UMovieSceneCustomizableTrack`（以及配套的 Customizable Section）。
在该蓝图里实现求值逻辑：按时间读取 Section 参数，写到绑定对象的属性或调用自定义函数；编译蓝图。
打开关卡 `Sequencer`，`+ Track` 添加你的自定义轨道类型，创建 Section，在曲线/关键帧上刷参数。
把轨道绑定到场景 Actor；播放/PIE 时确认自定义求值在 Tick 里改了目标，而不是普通 Transform/Animation 轨。
游戏模块只依赖 `CustomizableSequencerTracks`；`CustomizableSequencerTracksEditor` 仅进 Editor Target。
接口仍是 Experimental，不要把该轨类型写进必须跨引擎版本升级的过场资产。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Customizable Sequencer Tracks (Experimental)` (runtime `CustomizableSequencerTracks`, editor `CustomizableSequencerTracksEditor`).
Create a Blueprint class parented to `MovieSceneCustomizableTrack` / `UMovieSceneCustomizableTrack` (and the matching Customizable Section).
Implement evaluation in that Blueprint: read section parameters by time and write bound-object properties or custom functions, then compile.
In level `Sequencer`, `+ Track` your customizable track type, add a section, and key its parameters.
Bind the track to a scene actor; play/PIE and confirm custom evaluation mutates the target — it is not a Transform/Animation track.
Game modules depend on `CustomizableSequencerTracks` only; `CustomizableSequencerTracksEditor` stays on Editor targets.
The API is Experimental; do not bake this track type into cinematics that must survive engine upgrades.
note_cn: 蓝图可扩展的 Sequencer 轨，不是内置 Animation/Audio 轨的替代分类。
note_en: Blueprintable Sequencer tracks, not a stand-in for built-in Animation/Audio tracks.

cn_steps: 同时启用 `Electra Player` 与 `D3D12 Hardware accelerated video decoding plugin for the Electra media player`（模块 `D3D12VideoDecodersElectra`）。
在 `Project Settings > Engine > Rendering` 把 Default RHI 设为 `DirectX 12`；该解码器走 D3D12 Video，D3D11/Vulkan 不会走这条路径。
导入或指向 H.264/H.265 等 GPU 可硬解的封装，创建 `File Media Source`（或 Stream Media Source）和 `Media Player`，Player 选 Electra 而非 WMF。
把 `Media Texture` 接到材质或 `Media Plate`，蓝图调用 `Open Source` → `Play`。
看 Output Log 是否出现 `D3D12VideoDecodersElectra` 硬件解码成功；若回落到软件解码，检查 GPU 驱动、编解码器配置文件和 DXGI 适配器。
打包 Windows D3D12 目标时保留该插件；不要把它当独立 Media Component 加到 Actor 上。
en_steps: Enable both `Electra Player` and `D3D12 Hardware accelerated video decoding plugin for the Electra media player` (module `D3D12VideoDecodersElectra`).
Set Default RHI to `DirectX 12` in `Project Settings > Engine > Rendering`; this decoder uses D3D12 Video and will not run on D3D11/Vulkan.
Point a `File Media Source` (or stream source) at an H.264/H.265 file the GPU can decode, create a `Media Player`, and select Electra rather than WMF.
Assign the `Media Texture` to a material or `Media Plate` and Blueprint `Open Source` → `Play`.
Confirm `D3D12VideoDecodersElectra` hardware decode in the Output Log; if it falls back to software, check the GPU driver, codec profile, and DXGI adapter.
Keep the plugin on Windows D3D12 packaged targets. Do not add it as a Media Component on an actor.
note_cn: Electra 的 D3D12 硬解后端，不是新的播放器 UI。
note_en: Electra’s D3D12 hardware-decode backend, not a new player UI.

cn_steps: 启用 `Data Charts`（运行时 `DataCharts`，编辑器 `DataChartsEditor`）。
先建一张 `Data Table`：行结构含数值列（float/int）和用作类别轴的名字/枚举列，填入拍摄日志、镜头时长或设备读数。
内容浏览器新建 Data Chart 资产（`DataCharts`），指定源 `UDataTable`、系列列、图表类型（折线/柱状/散点）和坐标轴。
双击资产在编辑器图表视口核对系列；改 Data Table 行后刷新图表，确认虚拟制片仪表用的是表数据而不是手绘曲线。
需要进关卡/UMG 时用运行时 `DataCharts` 模块把同一数据源绑到图表控件；`DataChartsEditor` 只留在 Editor Target。
这是表驱动可视化，不要把它当成 Sequencer 曲线编辑器或 Control Rig 绘图工具。
en_steps: Enable `Data Charts` (runtime `DataCharts`, editor `DataChartsEditor`).
Create a `Data Table` whose row struct has numeric columns (float/int) plus a name/enum column for the category axis; fill shoot logs, shot durations, or device readings.
Create a Data Chart asset (`DataCharts`), point it at that `UDataTable`, pick series columns, chart type (line/bar/scatter), and axes.
Open the asset’s chart viewport; after editing table rows, refresh and confirm the VP dashboard reads table data, not hand-drawn curves.
For in-level/UMG use, bind the same source through the runtime `DataCharts` module; keep `DataChartsEditor` on Editor targets only.
This is table-driven visualization, not a Sequencer curve editor or Control Rig drawing tool.
note_cn: 从 Data Table 出图，服务 VP 仪表；编辑器模块勿进游戏包。
note_en: Charts from Data Tables for VP dashboards; keep the editor module out of the game package.

cn_steps: 启用 `Data-Driven Console Variables`（`DataDrivenConsoleVariables` + `DataDrivenConsoleVariablesEditor`）。
打开 `Project Settings` 里与 Data Driven CVars 相关的页（`UDataDrivenConsoleVariableSettings`），在数组中新增一项：`Name`（如 `ddc.Weapon.Recoil`）、`Type`（Bool/Int/Float/String）、Default、Tooltip。
不必重启编辑器：保存设置后按 `` ` `` 打开控制台，输入该名字应能自动完成并改值。
C++ 用 `IConsoleManager::Get().FindConsoleVariable(TEXT("ddc.Weapon.Recoil"))` 读 `GetFloat`/`GetInt`/`GetBool`；蓝图可用 `Execute Console Command` 做调试，正式逻辑走 CVar 指针。
PIE 中改控制台值应立刻反映；把资产/设置一起提交，让其他机器启动时 `DataDrivenConsoleVariables` 重新注册同名变量。
`DataDrivenConsoleVariablesEditor` 和 `DataDrivenConsoleVariablesTests` 不要进 Game Target；自动化可在 Session Frontend 筛 `DataDrivenConsoleVariables`。
en_steps: Enable `Data-Driven Console Variables` (`DataDrivenConsoleVariables` + `DataDrivenConsoleVariablesEditor`).
Open the Data Driven CVars page in `Project Settings` (`UDataDrivenConsoleVariableSettings`) and add a row: `Name` (e.g. `ddc.Weapon.Recoil`), `Type` (Bool/Int/Float/String), default, tooltip.
No editor restart: after saving, open the console with `` ` `` — the name should autocomplete and accept new values.

In C++ read `IConsoleManager::Get().FindConsoleVariable(TEXT("ddc.Weapon.Recoil"))` via `GetFloat`/`GetInt`/`GetBool`. Blueprints may `Execute Console Command` for debug; shipping logic should use the CVar pointer.
Changing the value in PIE should apply immediately. Check in the settings asset so other machines re-register the same names at startup.
Keep `DataDrivenConsoleVariablesEditor` and `DataDrivenConsoleVariablesTests` off Game targets; run tests from Session Frontend filtered to `DataDrivenConsoleVariables`.
note_cn: 用数据资产注册 CVar，免改 C++ 再编译；游戏启动时注册，编辑器可热更新。
note_en: Register CVars from data, no C++ rebuild; registered at game start, live-updated in editor.

cn_steps: 启用 `Data Registry`（运行时 `DataRegistry`，编辑器 `DataRegistryEditor`）。
内容浏览器创建 `Data Registry` 资产，设 `Registry Type`（`FDataRegistryType`，如 `Inventory.Item`），源类型选 `Data Table` 或 Curve Table，并指定行结构。
在 `Project Settings > Game > Data Registry` 把该资产加入启动加载列表，保证 `UDataRegistrySubsystem` 在运行时能找到它。
准备一张匹配行结构的 `Data Table`，行名即 `FDataRegistryId` 的 Item 部分；在源里指向这张表。
蓝图用 `Get Data Registry Item` / `Acquire Data Registry Item`（异步，源未加载时）；C++ 调 `UDataRegistrySubsystem::Get()->GetCachedItem<FMyRow>(FDataRegistryId)`。
PIE 中用已知 Id 取值，对照表内行；多源时确认优先级/覆盖规则，不要直接硬引用散落的 Data Table。
游戏模块只依赖 `DataRegistry`；`DataRegistryEditor` 仅编辑器。
en_steps: Enable `Data Registry` (runtime `DataRegistry`, editor `DataRegistryEditor`).
Create a `Data Registry` asset, set its `Registry Type` (`FDataRegistryType`, e.g. `Inventory.Item`), choose a `Data Table` or Curve Table source, and match the row struct.
Add the asset to the startup list in `Project Settings > Game > Data Registry` so `UDataRegistrySubsystem` can find it at runtime.
Author a `Data Table` with that row struct; row names are the Item part of `FDataRegistryId`. Point the registry source at the table.
In Blueprint use `Get Data Registry Item` or `Acquire Data Registry Item` (async if the source is unloaded). In C++ call `UDataRegistrySubsystem::Get()->GetCachedItem<FMyRow>(FDataRegistryId)`.
In PIE resolve a known Id and compare it to the table row. With multiple sources, check priority/override rules instead of hard-referencing scattered tables.
Game modules depend on `DataRegistry` only; `DataRegistryEditor` is editor-only.
note_cn: 运行时从多源取结构数据的统一接口，可进包装。
note_en: Generic runtime interface to pull struct data from multiple sources; can ship.

cn_steps: 启用编辑器插件 `Data Validation`（模块 `DataValidation`）；它提供校验 UI，默认不进 Shipping。
内容浏览器选中资产或文件夹，右键 `Asset Actions > Validate Assets`（或 `Tools > Validate Data`）跑一遍当前范围。
在 `Project Settings > Editor > Data Validation` 打开保存时校验、校验未保存资源、忽略列表等开关。
C++ 建 `UEditorValidatorBase` 子类，重写 `CanValidateAsset` / `ValidateLoadedAsset`，对非法引用、空软指针、命名规范返回 `EDataValidationResult::Invalid` 并 `AssetFails`。
Message Log 的 `Asset Check` 页查看错误/警告；修资产后再次 Validate，确认同一条不再出现。
CI 可用 `UnrealEditor-Cmd` 跑 Data Validation commandlet 扫整个项目；不要把 `DataValidation` 写进游戏 `Build.cs`。
en_steps: Enable the editor plugin `Data Validation` (module `DataValidation`). It is authoring UI and does not ship by default.
Select assets or a folder in the Content Browser and run `Asset Actions > Validate Assets` (or `Tools > Validate Data`).
Configure validate-on-save, unsaved assets, and ignore lists in `Project Settings > Editor > Data Validation`.

Subclass `UEditorValidatorBase` in C++, override `CanValidateAsset` / `ValidateLoadedAsset`, and return `EDataValidationResult::Invalid` with `AssetFails` for bad refs, null soft ptrs, or naming rules.
Read errors/warnings in Message Log `Asset Check`; fix the asset and re-validate until the same issue is gone.
On CI, run the Data Validation commandlet via `UnrealEditor-Cmd` over the project. Do not add `DataValidation` to a game `Build.cs`.
note_cn: 编辑器资产校验管线，不是运行时断言系统。
note_en: Editor asset-validation pipeline, not a runtime assert system.

cn_steps: 启用 `Database Support`（模块 `DatabaseSupport`）；这是抽象连接层，本身不带可视化查询窗口。
游戏或工具模块 `Build.cs` 依赖 `DatabaseSupport`，并同时启用具体后端（通常是 `SQLite` / SQLite Database 插件）以提供真正的 `FDataBaseConnection`。
`#include` 数据库记录集头文件，通过后端工厂打开连接字符串（本地 `.db` 或配置的 DSN），拿到 `FDataBaseConnection`。
调用 `Execute` 跑 SQL，用 `FDataBaseRecordSet` 迭代列；把结果填进游戏结构体或编辑器报表，而不是在蓝图里搜同名组件。
错误路径检查连接失败和 SQL 返回码；只读查询与写库分开事务，避免把玩家存档和调试库混在一个文件。
包装进游戏时带上所选后端插件；仅启用 `DatabaseSupport` 而不接 SQLite 等实现，运行时没有可用驱动。
en_steps: Enable `Database Support` (module `DatabaseSupport`). It is an abstract connection layer and has no visual query window.
Depend on `DatabaseSupport` in your game/tool `Build.cs` and also enable a concrete backend (typically the SQLite Database plugin) that supplies `FDataBaseConnection`.
Include the record-set headers, open a connection string (local `.db` or configured DSN) through the backend factory, and obtain `FDataBaseConnection`.
Run SQL with `Execute`, iterate `FDataBaseRecordSet` columns, and copy rows into gameplay structs or editor reports — there is no same-named actor component.
Handle connect failures and SQL return codes; keep read queries and writes in separate transactions so player saves never share a debug database file.
Package the chosen backend with the game. Enabling only `DatabaseSupport` without SQLite (or another driver) leaves you with no runtime engine.
note_cn: 抽象 DB API，必须搭配 SQLite 等具体插件才能真正连库。
note_en: Abstract DB API; pair it with SQLite or another driver or nothing connects.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 插件 `Dataflow Stroke Field`（`DataflowStrokeField` + `DataflowStrokeFieldEditor`），并确保 Dataflow 编辑器已开。
打开 `UDataflow` / Geometry Collection Dataflow 资产，切到 Construction 视口（不是关卡视口）。
在图中加入 Stroke Field 相关节点（方向场、权重场、弧长场），把输出接到形变、生长或沿切线分布的后续节点。
在 Construction 视口对着参考网格用鼠标/数位板涂抹笔划；笔划写入场采样，而不是画材质贴花。
求值 Dataflow，检查下游网格是否沿笔划方向拉伸/变密；擦除或重画笔划后再次求值。
`DataflowStrokeFieldEditor` 只进编辑器；运行时若求值场数据，游戏模块最多依赖 `DataflowStrokeField`。
Experimental 场格式可能变，不要把笔划资产当作长期互换格式。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Dataflow Stroke Field` (`DataflowStrokeField` + `DataflowStrokeFieldEditor`) and make sure the Dataflow editor is on.
Open a `UDataflow` / Geometry Collection Dataflow asset and switch to the Construction viewport (not the level viewport).
Add Stroke Field nodes (direction, weight, arc length) and wire them into deform, grow, or tangent-scatter nodes.
Draw over the reference mesh in the Construction viewport with mouse or stylus; strokes write field samples, they are not material decals.
Evaluate the graph and check that downstream meshes stretch or densify along the stroke. Erase or redraw, then evaluate again.
`DataflowStrokeFieldEditor` is editor-only; a game module may depend on `DataflowStrokeField` only if it evaluates stored fields at runtime.
The Experimental field format can change; do not treat stroke assets as a long-term interchange format.
note_cn: 在 Dataflow 构造视口手绘方向/权重/弧长场，不是关卡喷绘工具。
note_en: Hand-drawn direction/weight/arc-length fields in the Dataflow construction viewport, not a level spray tool.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental Toolset `DataflowAgent`（模块 `DataflowAgent`），并同时打开 Dataflow 编辑器；这是给编辑器 AI 助手的写图工具，不是游戏子系统。
打开一个 `Dataflow` 资产，让助手处于可调用 Toolset 的会话（Editor AI / Agent 面板）。
让代理列出当前图节点、按类型添加节点、连接引脚或改字面量参数；核对图上确实出现了新节点而不是只生成了文本说明。
求值 Dataflow，确认代理改过的节点输出符合你的约束（例如不要删掉终端 Output 节点）。
用 Undo 回滚一次代理编辑，确认事务落在 Dataflow 资产上。
不要把 `DataflowAgent` 写进 Game Target 或 Shipping；接口随夜构建可能变。
en_steps: Enable Experimental Toolset `DataflowAgent` (module `DataflowAgent`) together with the Dataflow editor. These are write tools for the in-editor AI assistant, not a game subsystem.
Open a `Dataflow` asset and start an assistant session that can invoke Toolsets (Editor AI / Agent panel).
Ask the agent to list nodes, add nodes by type, wire pins, or edit literals; confirm new nodes appear on the graph, not just in chat text.
Evaluate the Dataflow and check that agent edits still satisfy your constraints (for example, terminal Output nodes remain).
Undo one agent edit and confirm the transaction landed on the Dataflow asset.
Do not link `DataflowAgent` into a Game target or Shipping build; the contract can change on nightlies.
note_cn: 编辑器 AI 改 Dataflow 图的 Toolset，不进游戏包。
note_en: Editor-AI Toolset for mutating Dataflow graphs; not a shipping feature.

cn_steps: 启用 `DataflowVolumetric`（描述符 `DataflowVolumetricPlugin.uplugin`，模块 `DataflowVolumeCore` 与 `DataflowVolumeNodes`）。
打开 Geometry Collection / Dataflow 资产，在节点面板搜 Volume / Voxel / SDF 类节点（来自 `DataflowVolumeNodes`）。
放入体积源（网格转体素、隐式场或已有 volume 资产），设置体素分辨率、包围盒和对齐方式。
把体积接到采样、布尔、侵蚀或网格提取节点；求值后在预览里看切面密度，而不是只看表面三角。
需要运行时求值时，游戏模块依赖 `DataflowVolumeCore`（加必要的 `DataflowVolumeNodes`）；不要把体积节点当普通 Static Mesh 组件拖进关卡。
分辨率过高会爆内存：先用粗糙体素验证拓扑，再提高格子密度。
en_steps: Enable `DataflowVolumetric` (`DataflowVolumetricPlugin.uplugin`, modules `DataflowVolumeCore` and `DataflowVolumeNodes`).
Open a Geometry Collection / Dataflow asset and search the node palette for Volume / Voxel / SDF nodes from `DataflowVolumeNodes`.
Add a volume source (mesh-to-voxels, implicit field, or an existing volume asset) and set voxel resolution, bounds, and alignment.
Wire the volume into sample, boolean, erode, or mesh-extract nodes; after evaluate, inspect slice density in the preview, not only surface triangles.
If you evaluate at runtime, depend on `DataflowVolumeCore` (and `DataflowVolumeNodes` as needed). Do not drop volume nodes into a level as Static Mesh components.
High resolution explodes memory: prove topology on a coarse grid before refining the lattice.
note_cn: 给 Dataflow 加体积/体素节点，不是后处理雾体积。
note_en: Volumetric/voxel nodes for Dataflow, not post-process exponential height fog.

cn_steps: 启用 `Dataprep Editor`（`DataprepEditor`、`DataprepCore`、`DataprepLibraries`、`DataprepEditorScriptingUtilities`）。
内容浏览器新建 `Dataprep Asset`，在 Producer 里添加 Datasmith/FBX/USD 等输入，指向 CAD 或场景文件。
在 Dataprep 图里用 Filter 选出 Actor/静态网格/材质，再串 Operation（重命名、合并、替材质、设碰撞、改移动性），最后接到 Output。
点 `Execute` 跑管道，检查输出文件夹里生成的 Actor/网格；失败步骤看 Dataprep 日志而不是普通导入对话框。
参数稳定后可再执行覆盖输出；Python/编辑器脚本走 `DataprepEditorScriptingUtilities` 批处理多文件。
`DataprepEditor` 与 `DataprepEditorScriptingUtilities` 仅 Editor Target；不要把它们写进 Game `Build.cs`。
en_steps: Enable `Dataprep Editor` (`DataprepEditor`, `DataprepCore`, `DataprepLibraries`, `DataprepEditorScriptingUtilities`).
Create a `Dataprep Asset`, add Datasmith/FBX/USD producers, and point them at CAD or scene files.
In the Dataprep graph, Filter actors/static meshes/materials, chain Operations (rename, merge, replace materials, collision, mobility), and connect Output.
Click `Execute` and inspect spawned actors/meshes in the output folder; read the Dataprep log on failure, not the generic import dialog.
Re-execute to overwrite once parameters are stable. Batch extra files with Python via `DataprepEditorScriptingUtilities`.
`DataprepEditor` and `DataprepEditorScriptingUtilities` belong on Editor targets only — never a game `Build.cs`.
note_cn: 编辑器内的数据准备管道（导入→过滤→操作→输出），不是运行时关卡流送。
note_en: In-editor data-prep pipeline (import → filter → operate → output), not runtime level streaming.

cn_steps: 先启用 `Dataprep Editor`，再启用 Experimental 的 `Dataprep Geometry Operations`（模块 `DataprepGeometryOperations`）。
打开已有 `Dataprep Asset`，在操作节点列表里找几何处理项（简化、焊接、重网格、布尔、补洞等），它们不会出现在普通 Actor 组件菜单。
在 Filter 选出高面数 CAD 网格后接入这些 Operation，设目标三角数/容差。
`Execute` 后对比操作前后顶点数和法线；失败时看几何内核日志，而不是当普通 Import 选项。
把该插件当作 Dataprep 图扩展，不要在游戏运行时调用 `DataprepGeometryOperations`。
Experimental 操作签名可能变，管道资产升级引擎后要重新 Execute 验证。
en_steps: Enable `Dataprep Editor` first, then Experimental `Dataprep Geometry Operations` (module `DataprepGeometryOperations`).
Open a `Dataprep Asset` and look in the operation list for geometry processors (simplify, weld, remesh, boolean, fill holes). They do not appear on actor component menus.
Filter high-poly CAD meshes, then wire those operations with a target triangle count or tolerance.
`Execute` and compare vertex count and normals before vs after. On failure read the geometry-kernel log, not the generic import options.
Treat the plugin as a Dataprep graph extension; do not call `DataprepGeometryOperations` from game runtime.
Experimental operation signatures can change; re-Execute pipeline assets after an engine upgrade.
note_cn: 挂在 Dataprep 图上的实验几何算子，离开 Dataprep 编辑器没有独立窗口。
note_en: Experimental geometry operators hosted in the Dataprep graph; no standalone window outside that editor.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental Toolset `DataRegistryToolset`（模块 `DataRegistryToolset`），并确保 `Data Registry` 插件已启用且项目里有 Registry 资产。
打开编辑器 AI / Agent 会话，确认 Toolset 能看到已注册的 `FDataRegistryType` 列表。
让代理按 Type + Item 名查询 `FDataRegistryId`，核对返回的结构字段与 Data Table 行一致。
再让它列出某 Registry 的源（Data Table / Curve Table）和缓存状态；这是检查工具，不要让代理在会话里改玩法数值当正式管线。
对照 `UDataRegistrySubsystem` 在 PIE 中的 `GetCachedItem` 结果，确认助手读到的是同一缓存。
不要把 `DataRegistryToolset` 链进 Game Target；Shipping 游戏应只保留 `DataRegistry`。
en_steps: Enable Experimental Toolset `DataRegistryToolset` (module `DataRegistryToolset`) and make sure the `Data Registry` plugin is on with at least one registry asset.
Open an Editor AI / Agent session and confirm the Toolset can list registered `FDataRegistryType` values.
Have the agent resolve an `FDataRegistryId` by type + item name and check the struct fields against the Data Table row.
Ask it to list a registry’s sources (Data Table / Curve Table) and cache state. This is inspection, not a pipeline for changing gameplay numbers in chat.
Compare with `UDataRegistrySubsystem::GetCachedItem` in PIE so the assistant is reading the same cache.
Do not link `DataRegistryToolset` into a Game target; shipping games should keep only `DataRegistry`.
note_cn: 给编辑器 AI 查询 Data Registry 的 Toolset，不是运行时数据源。
note_en: Editor-AI Toolset to query Data Registries, not a runtime data source.
